finding: Review C-00: The source requires an adult forearm to occlude a torso with two coherent contour continuations. It adds an occluding gesture, not a cuff connection, and has no grounded existing-adult witness for native adoption. No part of this distinctive blocker is retained.

It requires an additional depicted scene and matching landmarks. Reinterpreting the BP monitor as a gesture display would change its role and introduce a different narrative; this source is not used.

The frozen clinic has no parked car or passenger seat, and effects cover action/pose only. It cannot become a clinic chair turn by renaming its target.

The frozen encounter lacks repair tools and the source scope is action/expression/pose. Borrowing cuff from it would confuse garment repair with clinical measurement; it is unused.

All source effects reviewed within open action/appearance/composition/count/pose/relationship/setting; no native-qualified adoption or facts are claimed.
